title: Payday Arcade
unlocks: payday badges, shift themes and milestones

games.name: Payslip Detective
games.how: Spot what's wrong (or right) on these made-up payslips.
games.teaches: Read your payslip like a pro. UK rules, April 2026 rates.

games.name: Payday Maths
games.how: Work out the pay. Rates are made up so the maths stays simple.
games.teaches: Check your own pay in seconds.

games.name: Clock In!
games.how: Catch the clock-ins and breaks. Dodge the unpaid extras.
games.teaches: All the time you're required to work counts for pay.

games.name: Break Time
games.how: Quick questions about UK breaks and rest.
games.teaches: Your legal rest breaks. UK rules, 2026.

games.name: Shift Matcher
games.how: Fine, clash or too little rest? Sort each pair of shifts.
games.teaches: Spot rota problems before they wear you out.

games.name: Workplace Quiz
games.how: Quick questions on UK work rights.
games.teaches: Know your basic rights. UK rules, 2026. Not legal advice: ACAS is free.

games.name: Overtime Challenge
games.how: How much would this overtime pay? Get as close as you can.
games.teaches: Know what extra hours are really worth before you say yes.

games.name: Shift Sprint
games.how: Put the steps in the right order.
games.teaches: What to do, in order, when something's wrong at work.
